liftRotor.note: Spinner down, supports under the blade tips only. PETG or PLA+, 0.12 mm layers, 5 walls, 100% infill. Mirror image of the main fan: it turns the other way. Balance it before running.

liftRing.note: Flared lip on the bed. 2 walls. Press it into the fan bay from the top.

impeller.note: Spinner down, supports under the blade tips only. PETG or PLA+, 0.12 mm layers, 5 walls, 100% infill. Balance it before running.

duct.note: Rear flange on the bed. The motor plate bridges 34 mm.

tailCone.note: Open end on the bed. Push fit; take it off to reach the motor screws.

seg1.note: Bearing-1 flange on the bed, supports on. The sleeve behind the flange must be smooth: the drive ring turns on it.

seg2.note: Lay the upstream bearing face on the bed: rotate 50 degrees in the slicer. Supports on.

seg3.note: Exit on the bed, supports under the flange.

collar.note: Flat. Print 4 (bearings 2 and 3). The two bumps carry the cords over the collar.

driveRing.note: Flat. Slip it over segment 1 from the front before the nozzle goes on the duct.

servoDrum.note: Flat, horn recess up. Print 2. The stock servo horn presses into the recess; the horn screw goes through the centre.
